hinglish: Bhai ye photo dekh ke toh phone bhi blush kar raha hai.
english_meaning: Bro, even the phone is blushing seeing this photo.

hinglish: Traditional wear mein tu aisa lag raha hai jaise cultural ambassador ho.
english_meaning: In traditional wear you look like a cultural ambassador.

hinglish: Is smile pe copyright lagwa le, warna sab ispe gaye.
english_meaning: Get a copyright on this smile, or everyone will fall for it.

hinglish: Sunset toh acha hai, par frame mein tu ho toh aur bhi.
english_meaning: The sunset is nice, but with you in the frame it's even better.

hinglish: Khana toh tasty lag raha, par company tu hoti toh aur maza.
english_meaning: The food looks tasty, but it'd be more fun with you there.

hinglish: Mirror bhi lucky hai jo roj tu usme dekhta hai.
english_meaning: Even the mirror is lucky that you look into it every day.

hinglish: In aankhon mein doob jaane ka mann kar raha hai.
english_meaning: I feel like drowning in these eyes.

hinglish: Black pe tu itna acha lagta hai, jaise black tere liye bana ho.
english_meaning: You look so good in black, as if black was made for you.

hinglish: Already itna fit hai, gym jaane ke baad toh hum kya karenge.
english_meaning: You're already so fit; after the gym what will we do?

hinglish: Candid shots mein tera magic zyada hai, poses pe nahi.
english_meaning: There's more magic in your candid shots than in posed ones.

hinglish: Bas tu soch raha tha, aur ab tu aa gaya screen pe.
english_meaning: Just thinking about you, and now you've appeared on my screen.

hinglish: Kuch khaas nahi, bas tera notification ka wait.
english_meaning: Nothing special, just waiting for your notification.

hinglish: Bore ho raha tha, tu message kar de toh din ban jaaye.
english_meaning: I was bored; if you message, the day will be made.

hinglish: Tera khayal aa raha tha, aur ab tu khud aa gaya.
english_meaning: I was thinking of you, and now you've shown up yourself.

hinglish: Bas ek kaam kar raha - tera reply ka wait.
english_meaning: Just doing one thing - waiting for your reply.

hinglish: Khaya, par dessert ka wait hai tera message.
english_meaning: Ate, but waiting for your message like dessert.

hinglish: Nahi abhi, tu khilayega kya?
english_meaning: Not yet; will you feed me?

hinglish: Khaya, par teri voice sun ke hi full satisfaction.
english_meaning: Ate, but full satisfaction only on hearing your voice.

hinglish: Tune pucha toh bhookh gayi, ab tu khila de.
english_meaning: You asked, so hunger's gone; now feed me.

hinglish: Khaya, par tera saath hota toh aur maza.
english_meaning: Ate, but it'd be more fun with you around.

hinglish: Koi nahi, celebrities busy hote hain.
english_meaning: No problem, celebrities are busy.

hinglish: Parle, tera message ka wait toh kar hi sakta hoon.
english_meaning: It's fine, I can always wait for your message.

hinglish: Late aaya par mood set kar diya.
english_meaning: You came late but set the mood.

hinglish: Next time late aaya toh coffee treat dena padega.
english_meaning: Next time you're late, you'll owe a coffee treat.

hinglish: Reply late aaya, par dil ka beat fast ho gaya.
english_meaning: Reply came late, but my heart raced.

hinglish: Doctor hai kya? Kyun ki teri photo dekh ke BP badh gaya.
english_meaning: Are you a doctor? Because my BP rose seeing your photo.

hinglish: Google Maps bhi tera heart nahi dhoondh pa raha, location share kar.
english_meaning: Even Google Maps can't find your heart; share location.

hinglish: WiFi hotspot on hai kya? Automatically attract ho raha hoon.
english_meaning: Is WiFi hotspot on? I'm getting automatically attracted.

hinglish: Swim nahi aata, par teri aankhon mein doobna chahta hoon.
english_meaning: I can't swim, but I want to drown in your eyes.

hinglish: Police complaint karunga - neend chura li tu ne.
english_meaning: I'll file a police complaint - you stole my sleep.

hinglish: Magnet hai kya tu? Main iron hoon kya?
english_meaning: Are you a magnet? Am I iron?

hinglish: Google Pay kar dunga, sapne mein aa ja zara.
english_meaning: I'll Google Pay you; come into my dreams a bit.

hinglish: Phone charge nahi, par tu baat kar toh full energy.
english_meaning: Phone has no charge, but talking to you gives full energy.

hinglish: Magician hai kya? Problems gayab ho gaye tujhe dekh ke.
english_meaning: Are you a magician? Problems vanished seeing you.

hinglish: Exam mein itne doubts nahi the, jitne tere baare mein daily aate hain.
english_meaning: Even in exams I had no doubts, but thoughts of you come daily.

hinglish: Din ka best part hai teri baat ka woh chhota sa time.
english_meaning: The best part of the day is that little time talking to you.

hinglish: Tu smile kare toh din worth ho jaata hai.
english_meaning: Your smile makes the day worth it.

hinglish: Bahut mila hoon, par tu jaisa koi nahi.
english_meaning: I've met many, but no one like you.

hinglish: Tu paas ho toh silence bhi music lagta hai.
english_meaning: With you near, even silence feels like music.

hinglish: Playlist ka favourite song bhi teri voice se kam hai.
english_meaning: Even my favourite song is less than your voice.

hinglish: Tujhe milne ke baad perfection ka matlab samjha.
english_meaning: After meeting you I understood what perfection means.

hinglish: Kitne bhi messages aaye, tera notification ka wait.
english_meaning: No matter how many messages, I wait for your notification.

hinglish: Tu aaya life mein toh normal days bhi special ho gaye.
english_meaning: You came into my life and even normal days became special.

hinglish: Tujhe dekh ke time ruk jaaye toh acha lage.
english_meaning: I wish time would stop when I look at you.

hinglish: Simple bolun toh, happiness ka shortcut tu hai.
english_meaning: Simply put, you're the shortcut to happiness.

hinglish: Chat pe itna vibe hai, mil ke kaisa hoga?
english_meaning: The chat vibe is so good; how would meeting be?

hinglish: Weekend free hai? Ek acha coffee spot jaante hain, chalein?
english_meaning: Free this weekend? I know a good coffee spot, shall we go?

hinglish: Typing se fingers dard kar rahe, call kar le na?
english_meaning: My fingers hurt from typing; will you call?

hinglish: Long drive chalein? Music main launga, company tu de.
english_meaning: Shall we go on a long drive? I'll bring music, you bring company.

hinglish: Phone screen dekh dekh ke bore ho gaya, real mein kab milenge?
english_meaning: Bored of seeing you on screen; when do we meet in real?
